representation_fit.evidence: Brief demands a single high-consequence workflow (brief.md:27-33); implementation is exactly that: a 12-step, 4-phase decommission runbook (source/data.js:11-183) rendered as journey-map + focused step card (screenshots/1280x860.png, 1440x900.png), with a strict single pointer forbidding skips (source/app.js:29,428). One flow, high hierarchy, no comparison/spatial facets — matches the shape bundle.

primary_task_salience.evidence: On both screenshots/1280x860.png and 1440x900.png the current step ('核对变更单与执行窗口', breadcrumb 阶段1·准备/步骤1/12) dominates the main column with its 3 gate checkboxes and the single CTA '完成本步骤' (source/app.js:266-288); header/journey are supporting context only.

time_to_understand.evidence: Initial screen self-explains within seconds: brand-sub 'CHG-20260919-0417 · 生产服务器安全下线' (app.js:121), journey header '… · 12 步' (app.js:139-140), gate label '门禁校验（全部通过后方可完成本步骤）' (app.js:255-256), footer policy '零失误目标…' (index.html:37) and progress '0 / 12 步' (app.js:132-134) — both viewports render fully with no loading state (synchronous renderAll at app.js:600, inline data per data.js:1).

navigation_cost.evidence: Primary object (current step) is reached in 0 steps on load (app.js:600). Completed-step review is 1 click (journey buttons app.js:508-515; '返回当前步骤' app.js:543); execution log and reset are 1 click each (index.html:24-25). Locking of future steps (app.js:155,511) is brief-mandated zero-mistake gating, not navigation overhead; undo is a persistent top strip when active (app.js:180-197).

context_loss.evidence: Single-page, all actions in place: completion re-renders the focus card while header/journey persist (app.js:419-438); confirm modal is an overlay that restores focus to its trigger (app.js:444-475) and canceling keeps all state; undo cascades back within the same screen (app.js:478-505); Escape closes modal/drawer (app.js:581-585). No routes, no page loads, no mode switches.

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent surfaces are lean: header (badge + 2 buttons, index.html:22-26), journey index, one step card (3 checkboxes + 1 button). Transient surfaces appear only on need: undo strip only when a window is active (app.js:183), drawer/modal hidden by default (index.html:44,56), certificate only after step 12 (app.js:231-234). Each control maps to the brief's zero-mistake/confirmation requirements.

accessibility.evidence: Receipt fails 3 of 4 a11y checks: a11y.contrast=fail, a11y.target_size=fail, type.min_projected_size=fail (measurement-summary.json checks), consistent with pervasive 11–13.5px muted text (styles.css:80,180,185,422), 16px checkbox targets (styles.css:260), .btn.sm 4px padding (styles.css:108), and locked-step gray #9aa8bc (styles.css:201). Credit for structure: a11y.focus_order=pass plus role=dialog/aria-modal (index.html:56), modal focus trap and Escape (app.js:587-596), :focus-visible outline (styles.css:53-57), role=alert gate error (app.js:397).

frontend_rework.evidence: No visible layout defects: layout.overflow=pass, layout.responsive_collision=pass, text.truncation=pass (measurement-summary.json), and both screenshots (1280x860, 1440x900) show clean aligned grids. However the three failed a11y checks (contrast, target_size, min_projected_size) imply a styling rework pass would be required, plus a minor state bug: .btn:disabled:hover forces danger background on any disabled button (styles.css:121).

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '不可逆步骤有恢复/确认路径' is covered end-to-end: all 4 irreversible steps carry consequence+recovery data (data.js:65-71,118-124,133-138,165-170); pre-execution preview shows both blocks (app.js:241-251); confirmation modal requires an ack checkbox before enabling '确认执行' (index.html:71-79, app.js:576-578); timed undo windows with one-click undo and cascade rollback (app.js:478-505); recovery paths retained in read-only review (app.js:298-304); final audit table lists each irreversible action's confirmation and recovery (app.js:327-341); warning flags mark them in the journey (app.js:156-158).

defects_observed: a11y.contrast=fail and a11y.target_size=fail and type.min_projected_size=fail (measurement-summary.json): small muted type (11–12.5px, styles.css:180,422), 16px checkboxes (styles.css:260), 4px-padded small buttons (styles.css:108), locked-step gray #9aa8bc (styles.css:201)
.btn:disabled:hover applies danger background to every disabled button on hover (styles.css:121) — cosmetic state bug visible only on the disabled modal confirm/log buttons
a11y receipt covers only the initial page; post-interaction states (modal, undo strip, certificate) are verified from source only (app.js:241-341,478-505), not by any of the seven checks
scores.overall_note: The package presents a single-screen, zero-dependency guided runbook ('下线指挥台') whose representation matches the brief's consequential-flow shape precisely: one 12-step high-consequence workflow with strict linear progression, gate checkboxes before any step completes, and a confirmation-door + recovery-path apparatus on every irreversible step, satisfying the acceptance seed in data (data.js irrev blocks), UI (modal with ack checkbox, undo countdown strip), and audit output (certificate table). The initial screen is fully ready on load (inline data.js, synchronous render at app.js:600) and legible in seconds at both 1280x860 and 1440x900 with no layout defects in the receipt. The clear weakness is measured accessibility: three of the seven checks fail (contrast, target size, minimum projected type size), corroborated by systematically small/muted typography and control sizes in styles.css, which would require a real rework pass and slightly damages the zero-mistake usability goal; focus order and programmatic focus management are nonetheless well built. Task completion time, retrieval accuracy, and human preference are not observable in this blind pilot; model-judged understandability here is a proxy, not human preference.
